name: Moses
overview: Scripture reveals Moses as a Levite born into a time of great peril for his people, hidden in a basket by the riverbank and miraculously discovered and adopted by Pharaoh's daughter. As he matured, Moses identified with his Hebrew brethren, which led to a confrontation resulting in his flight to Midian where he became a herdsman for Jethro. It was there, at Mount Horeb, that God appeared to him in the burning bush, commissioning him to lead Israel out of Egypt, marking the beginning of his divinely appointed mission.
